title: Common Widgets 🖼️
description: Work with Text, Image, Button, and other essential UI elements.

slides.title: The Palette of Widgets 🎨
slides.content:
# Building Blocks

The **Palette** (left side of Designer) lists all widgets:

* **Common** – Border, Button, Image, Text
* **Input** – Check Box, Slider, Text Box
* **Panels** – Canvas, Grid, Vertical Box
* **Primitive** – Progress Bar, Throbber (spinner), Combo Box

Drag them onto the canvas or into layout panels.

slides.title: Text Block 🔤
slides.content:
## Show Words

The **Text Block** widget displays text with full styling:

* **Text** – the string to display.
* **Font** – family, size, colour, outline.
* **Justification** – left, center, right.
* **Auto Wrap** – if enabled, text wraps to the next line.

Use it for labels, titles, and dynamic messages. You can change the text at runtime via Blueprint (Binding or direct set).

quizData.question: To make text automatically continue on the next line, enable _____ Wrap.
quizData.explanation: Auto Wrap causes the text to break at the widget's width.

slides.title: Image 🖼️
slides.content:
## Display Pictures

The **Image** widget shows a texture or material:

* **Brush** – the image texture (set via Texture or Material).
* **Tint** – colour multiply.
* Use for icons, backgrounds, or crosshairs.

You can also use a **Material** in the brush for animated or masked effects.

slides.title: Button 🔘
slides.content:
## Clickable Element

The **Button** widget is a clickable area that fires events:

* Contains a single child (usually a Text or Image).
* In the Events section of Details, add **OnClicked** → which creates an event node in the Graph.
* Style the background, hover, pressed states via **Style**.

Buttons are the primary way players interact with menus.

quizData.question: A Button widget can contain multiple child widgets directly.
quizData.explanation: Button has exactly one child slot. To hold multiple widgets, place a panel (like Horizontal Box) inside the button as the child.

slides.title: Pro Tip 🚀
slides.content:
## Reuse Widgets

Create a separate Widget Blueprint for a complex button (e.g., `WBP_MenuButton`) and then insert it into other widgets as a **User Created** widget from the Palette.
